14_day_block_bootstrap.root_cause_summary: The simultaneous max-|T| studentizer explodes because sparse candidates (with few non-zero blocks) frequently yield all-zero resamples where sample variance vanishes. The denominator b_se is clamped to floor=1e-06, producing t = |mean| / floor on the order of 10^6. Whenever the all-zero draw probability exceeds 5% (which occurs for any candidate with k <= 2 non-zero blocks), the simultaneous q95 is mathematically forced to this million-scale artifact, blowing up confidence intervals for all evaluated candidates regardless of their individual sample properties.
